FULL TEXT:
ASSISTANT CASHIER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 53/R&A Dated: 22nd July, 2025
All the candidates of Assistant Cashier Recruitment Examination, 2024, notified
under Advertisement No. PHC/02/2024 dated 28th May, 2024 are hereby informed that the scores
of the Computer based Written Test (Objective type) held on 24th August, 2024, Computer
Proficiency Test held on 22nd March, 2025 as well as Interview held on 30th April, 2025 have been
uploaded on the website of the Court. The candidates may view their scores by clicking on the
link given on Court’s website using their login credentials provided to them at the time of
registration.
The candidates must take notice that the link shall remain active till 31st August, 2025
only.
Besides, in light of Clause 12(xxx) of the above referred advertisement, no application
under RTI Act, 2005 seeking information relating to scores and cut-off marks of the Assistant
Cashier Recruitment Examination, 2024, shall be entertained.
By order of the Court
Sd/- P.K. Malik
Registrar General
